claim: Patchline ships a replicable public corpus API serving versioned, content-pinned hazard statistics. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the replicable corpus API claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make replicable-corpus-api-gate`.
